Name: JAC'd - Safety Net Slime Hutch
Author: Androxilogin
Description:
A simple Slime Hutch edit to keep you safe while raising the wild beasts. This mod will add a barrier within the hutch that slimes will not cross.

[b][UPDATE] 10/28/2016 - [/b]New file added due to troughs not properly storing water (with special thanks to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/239491]ikhwan1986[/url] for bringing it to my attention). New layout pictured below. Sorry if you were partial to the old layout but it had to be done this way because the info is hardcoded into the game and unchangeable. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/5B2EN9hl.jpg[/img]
